theme.description: Blends dark high-contrast IDE/terminal vibe with clean, highly readable modern documentation architecture. Features glowing status dots, subtle scanlines, monospace accents, copy-to-clipboard code blocks, and crisp structural borders.

headings.eyebrow: font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.25em] text-emerald-400 font-semibold

body.code: font-mono text-xs sm:text-sm bg-slate-900/90 text-emerald-300 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-slate-700/60

visual_enhancers.grid_background: subtle terminal grid pattern (1px slate lines on 32px spacing)
visual_enhancers.terminal_topbar: Mac style dots (red, yellow, green) with filepath indicator in header of code blocks
visual_enhancers.badges: rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-mono font-medium border

navigation.sidebar: Collapsible left nav with active tool indicators, platform filter pills (Mac, Windows, WSL, Container, Remote SSH, Corporate), workflow stage accordion, and keyboard shortcut search trigger (Cmd+K).
navigation.header: Sticky top bar with breadcrumb trail, quick status indicators, theme switcher, and 'Get Started / Decision Guide' primary CTA.

interactive_ecosystem_map.container: Hero visual canvas with React Flow pan/zoom, layer backgrounds (Filesystem -> Context Governor -> Structural Graph -> Agent Interface), node status indicators, animated data edges, node click inspector side drawer.
interactive_ecosystem_map.controls: Zoom in/out/reset fit view, layout toggle (horizontal pipeline / vertical stack / layer grouped), search/filter by tool or layer.

knowledge_base.structure: Tool hero header, quick stats bar (Token Cost Saved, Latency Reduction, Recommended Setup Time), Deep Dive Tabs: (1) What & Why, (2) Token Waste Reduction Mechanics, (3) Recommended Adoption Order, (4) Platform Notes (Mac, Windows, WSL, Docker/Containers, Remote SSH, Corporate Proxies).

guided_setup_wizard.structure: Step-by-step progress stepper per tool, OS/Environment selector tabs, step instructions, copy-to-clipboard command blocks with instant visual toast, validation checkpoint toggle (Mark Step Tested & Verified), troubleshooting drawer with collapsible common error solutions.

decision_support_guide.questionnaire: 5-step interactive questionnaire (Repo Size, Primary Languages, Team Size, AI Agent Model e.g. Claude 3.7 / GPT-4.5, Monthly Token Budget / Cost Sensitivity).
decision_support_guide.output: Dynamic Recommended Stack calculation, architecture diagram breakdown, cost savings projection calculator, tradeoff matrix table, cost-optimization playbook.

hero_workspace.description: Code monitor background for hero background texture

testing_attributes.rule: Every button, link, tab, input, checkbox, modal, and tool node MUST contain data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page React SPA with smooth state-driven navigation (or React Router) for Hub Hero, Ecosystem Map, Knowledge Base pages, Guided Setup Wizard, Decision Support Guide, and Search Modal.
Ensure dark mode is default with a clean light mode toggle that persists in state.
Include copy-to-clipboard support using navigator.clipboard or fallback with visual toast notification (sonner).
Integrate interactive SVG/Canvas or custom React Flow graph component for the Ecosystem Map with click-to-open drawer, layer badges, animated edges, and node filtering.

Make sure all 6 tools (Graft, Serena, Graphify, Codebase Memory, Archify, Agentsview) have rich deep-dive content, realistic code snippets, terminal setup commands, validation commands, and troubleshooting guides.
Ensure every interactive element has explicit data-testid attributes for automated testing.
